name: Smallpox outbreak response: traced (ring) versus mass vaccination
description:
Smallpox, human; emergency public-health vaccination response.
This is a public-health response-logistics model: the policy question it answers is whether contact-traced vaccination or population-wide vaccination averts more deaths given a finite daily vaccination capacity.
Parameter values: 0 of 11 checked against the source; the rest are recalled or illustrative.
reference: Kaplan EH, Craft DL, Wein LM (2002). Emergency response to a smallpox attack: the case for mass vaccination. PNAS 99(16):10935–10940

compartments.name: E
compartments.description: infected, latent (not infectious, not yet symptomatic)

parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: transmission rate (gives roughly 3 secondary cases per infectious person over the symptomatic period) [illustrative] (per day)

parameters.name: sigma
parameters.description: rate of leaving latency (mean latent period ≈14 d) [unverified] (per day)

parameters.name: theta
parameters.description: rate at which symptomatic cases are detected and isolated (≈3 d from rash to isolation) [illustrative] (per day)

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.description: rate of resolution (recovery or death) in isolation [illustrative] (per day)

parameters.name: cfr
parameters.description: case fatality of ordinary variola major [unverified] (dimensionless)

parameters.name: eps_pre
parameters.description: efficacy of vaccination of a susceptible [illustrative] (dimensionless)

parameters.name: eps_post
parameters.description: efficacy of post-exposure vaccination of a latent individual (protection declines sharply after the first few days) [illustrative] (dimensionless)

parameters.name: tau_v
parameters.description: delay before the vaccination campaign starts [illustrative] (days)

parameters.name: nu_ring
parameters.description: traced-vaccination intensity [illustrative] (contacts traced and vaccinated per isolated case per day)

parameters.name: nu_mass
parameters.description: per-capita mass-vaccination rate once the campaign is running [illustrative] (per day)

parameters.name: cap
parameters.description: maximum daily vaccination throughput [illustrative] (doses per day)

variables.name: N
variables.expr: S + E + Ii + Q + V + R

variables.name: rate_v
variables.description: per-capita vaccination rate, capped by logistic throughput
